description: An agent-based, network-structured simulation of mask adoption dynamics where individuals interact across locations, exchange information, face policy and enforcement, and experience supply constraints. Adoption behavior evolves from social influence, risk perception, mandates, and fatigue; disease transmission is modulated by mask use and location context.

parameters.age_distribution: US-like broad distribution or supplied dataset

parameters.spatial_assignment: uniform across locations of type home

modules.name: NetworkManager
modules.description: Generates and maintains the social network topology for Person-Person interactions and optional rewiring.

notes: Primary network is static; optional rewiring can model churn or mobility-induced ties.

modules.name: MobilityAndLocation
modules.description: Allocates daily attendance to locations for each person based on mobility patterns and contact budgets.

notes: Contact fractions by type should sum to 1; capacity utilization caps participants per location.

modules.name: MediaInformation
modules.description: Simulates information and misinformation dissemination from media and campaigns; updates person exposures.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each media outlet m:
  broadcast info ~ reach * trustworthiness * information_campaign_intensity
  broadcast misinfo ~ reach * misinformation_rate * (1 - trustworthiness) * media_bias_factor
aggregate exposure per person based on subscriptions and random reach
update person.information_exposure and misinformation_exposure with decay
notes: Campaign intensity scales info messages; exposure decays implicitly via overwrite or explicit decay.

modules.name: EnforcementPolicy
modules.description: Controls mandates, enforcement probability, and fines; emits policy signals to locations and persons.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == mandate_on_day: policy.mandate_state = ON
if t == mandate_off_day: policy.mandate_state = OFF
policy.enforcement_prob = enforcement_probability
policy.fine_amount = fine_amount
for each location l:
  l.mandate_level = policy.mandate_state for scope
notes: Scope determines which location types are mandated; enforcement occurs during interactions.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Updates each person's mask adoption state based on social influence, risk, mandates, fatigue, and cost/access.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  peer_rate = mean(adoption_state of neighbors)
  risk = p.risk_perception
  policy_term = mandate_effect * 1{in mandated contexts} * p.compliance_propensity
  info_term = +information_exposure - misinformation_exposure
  score = sigmoid( alpha*peer_rate + beta*risk + policy_term + info_term - gamma*p.fatigue_level )
  if p.adoption_state == 0:
    adopt_prob = score
    if random < adopt_prob and masks available and budget allows:
      p.purchase_masks(min_days_between_purchase)
      set p.adoption_state = 1 and select mask_type by availability and price
  else:
    dropout_prob = dropout_rate + adoption_fatigue_rate * p.fatigue_level
    if random < dropout_prob: p.adoption_state = 0
  update p.fatigue_level = max(0, p.fatigue_level + fatigue_increment - fatigue_recovery_rate)
  update p.risk_perception = bounded_update(perceived_risk_sensitivity * recent_cases_signal)
collect aggregate retail demand from purchase attempts
notes: alpha=peer_influence_weight, beta=risk_perception_weight, gamma relates to adoption_fatigue_rate; price and inventory gate adoption.

modules.name: RetailSupply
modules.description: Manages mask inventories, pricing, rationing, and sales to people.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  restock = min(retailer_daily_restock_rate, mask_supply_capacity_per_day/retailer_count)
  r.inventory += restock
  effective_price = mask_price_base * (1 + price_adjustment_sensitivity * demand_pressure)
  if rationing_rule_enabled:
    limit per purchase = rationing_limit_per_purchase
  fulfill demand in arrival order subject to inventory and rationing
  record sales and if r.inventory == 0: inventory_outage_flag
notes: Demand pressure computed as recent demand/inventory; price controls from policy can be applied upstream via inputs.

modules.name: DiseaseTransmission
modules.description: Simulates infection events given contact pairs, mask use, location modifiers, and health states; manages recovery.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_infections = 0
for each contact (i, j, location l):
  if one infectious and one susceptible:
    eff_out_i, eff_in_j = mask_efficacy(i.mask_type, j.mask_type)
    base_p = transmission_probability_per_contact * l.transmission_modifier
    p_trans = base_p * (1 - eff_out_i) * (1 - eff_in_j)
    if random < p_trans: infect susceptible
account for importation_rate random infections
update recoveries based on infectious_period and recovery_period
estimate Rt = new_infections / infectious_person_days * scaling
notes: Mask efficacy multiplies outward and inward reductions; vaccination reduces susceptibility; asymptomatic may have reduced infectiousness.

modules.name: HouseholdInfluence
modules.description: Models intra-household influence on adoption and resource sharing of masks.

notes: Resource sharing can reduce purchase demand and enable adoption under supply constraints.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(p.adoption_state over all persons)
for each location type T:
  compliance_T = mean(mask use among attendees in T)
emit observables
notes: Compliance by type uses attendance-weighted averages.

modules.name: InfectionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates infection prevalence, incidence, and effective reproduction number.

update_rule.pseudocode:
incidence = count(new_infections)
prevalence = current infectious count
Rt = estimated Rt
attack_rate += incidence / population_size

modules.name: InventoryAggregator
modules.description: Tracks inventory outages and sales totals.

update_rule.pseudocode:
outage_day = any(retailer inventory == 0) ? 1 : 0
masks_sold = sum(retail.sales)
emit

modules.name: EquityAggregator
modules.description: Computes adoption gaps across subgroups (e.g., income, age).

update_rule.pseudocode:
split population by income tertiles; compute adoption mean in top vs bottom; gap = top - bottom
split by age groups; compute adoption gaps similarly
emit

algorithms.SmallWorldNetworkGeneration: Watts-Strogatz graph with N=population_size, k≈average_degree, beta=0.05
algorithms.ContactAllocation: Poisson draws for contact budgets and stratified allocation across location types with capacity constraints
algorithms.MaskEfficacyComposition: Combine outward and inward efficacy multiplicatively per dyad given mask types
algorithms.RtEstimation: Cori method approximation: Rt = I_t / sum_{s} I_{t-s} w_s, approximated via infectious person-days
